description: The organization has not established a formal capacity planning process. This signal indicates the absence of procedures for monitoring and projecting system capacity needs to ensure availability.
applicability: Organizations pursuing SOC 2 certification, Service organizations with availability requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection involves reviewing capacity planning documentation, examining monitoring configurations, and verifying that capacity projections are performed.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
